text: When you arrive, you get a wristband with one number.

text: That number is on every chart, in every department: the lab, the scan, the ward.

text: Anyone can follow your whole stay by that one number.

text: Here, every request gets the same kind of number.

text: We call it a trace: one number that follows a request from the moment it arrives until its answer leaves.
prefix: We call it a trace: one number that follows a request from the moment it arrives until its answer leaves.

text: When ecom calls the card zone, the trace goes along.
prefix: When ecom calls the card zone, the trace goes along.

text: When the card zone calls an adapter, it goes along again.

text: Every answer names its trace too, even an answer that says no.

text: A merchant's server can quote that number to support, and support finds the whole story in seconds.

text: Every log line carries the same number.
prefix: Every log line carries the same number.

text: So a warning in one log leads straight to the request that caused it, and to every other line about that request.

text: Now the card numbers.
prefix: Now the card numbers.

text: Before any line is written, it is cleaned.
prefix: Before any line is written, it is cleaned.

text: This is log masking.
prefix: This is log masking.

text: A card number keeps only its first six and its last four digits; the middle becomes stars.
prefix: A card number keeps only its first six and its last four digits; the middle becomes stars.

text: Any long run of digits that could be a card number is treated as one.
prefix: Any long run of digits that could be a card number is treated as one.

text: A token keeps only its last four characters.
prefix: A token keeps only its last four characters.

text: Passwords and secrets are hidden completely.
prefix: Passwords and secrets are hidden completely.

text: This happens on every line, wherever the line is sent.
prefix: This happens on every line, wherever the line is sent.

text: So nothing the running system writes can leak a card.
prefix: So nothing the running system writes can leak a card.

text: Each product sends all of this to its own monitoring.

text: ecom has its own, and the card zone runs its own, separately.
